content: We need number of C=O groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly need to get IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR? But we don't have SMILES. The system likely has a sample "at hand". We can request IR spectra which will show C=O stretch peaks. Or carbon NMR may show carbonyl carbons ~200 ppm. The cheapest is IR? Both are cheap. Use ir_spectra tool. Then count number of C=O peaks (around 1700-1750 cm-1). Let's call tool.
